title: Whispering Whorl Whelk
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the size of a teacup, it drifts through a tank of moonlit teal water and glides slowly along a driftwood arch hung with glowing moss. Each time it lifts its foot, it releases a tiny chime-like bubble that rises past the ferns and pops with a soft 'pip,' so the whole tank seems to be murmuring secrets to itself.
